fullPassage: All human cultures mark the passing of time by the differences they observe in the world around them. Our choice of which differences to mark depend firstly on what we can observe and secondly on what is important in our lives. How we mark the differences — the shapes of our calendars and our rituals — depends on the connections we make between those two things. In the agricultural society of pre-modern Europe, where higher latitudes make the seasons easily observable, it was natural to monitor the solar cycle. Conversely, among the largely nomadic peoples of Arabia, seasonal changes were less significant, the lunar calendar was a more sensible choice. That did not make it inevitable that Islam would use a lunar calendar and Roman Christianity a solar one, but political and religious decisions were made from options limited by geography and lifestyle, filtered through tradition.

✅ ① (A) 추적하다 — (B) 화면: (A) 태양 주기를 지속적으로 관찰·추적하는 동사, (B) 컴퓨터 모니터(화면) 명사 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 화면 — (B) 추적하다: (A)는 태양 주기를 '관찰·추적'하는 동사, (B)는 컴퓨터 '화면'이라 서로 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 추적하다 — (B) 추적하다: (B)는 컴퓨터 화면(명사)이라 '추적하다'가 아님
❌ ④ (A) 화면 — (B) 화면: (A)는 관찰하는 동사이므로 '화면'이 아님
det.tip: monitor: 관찰·추적하다(동사), 컴퓨터 화면·모니터(명사) 등 다의어. 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "moving from place to place rather than living in one fixed location"

det.korean: 한 곳에 정착하지 않고 이곳저곳 옮겨 다니는 = 유목의(nomadic)
det.analysis:
❌ ① agricultural(농업의) — 정착하여 농사짓는 것과 관련되어 반대 개념
❌ ② urban(도시의) — 도시에 사는 것으로 '이동'과 무관
❌ ③ coastal(해안의) — 위치를 나타낼 뿐 이동 여부와 무관
✅ ④ nomadic(유목의) — 한 곳에 머물지 않고 옮겨 다니는 ←정답
det.tip: nomadic = 유목의 ↔ settled(정착한). 아라비아의 유목 민족

questions.passage: How we mark the differences — the shapes of our calendars and our rituals — depends on the connections we make between those two things. In the agricultural society of pre-modern Europe, where higher latitudes make the seasons easily __________ (observe), it was natural to monitor the solar cycle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: observe(동사) → observable(형용사). 계절이 '관찰 가능한'
det.analysis: make + 목적어 + 형용사(계절을 ~하게 만들다) 구조라 형용사가 필요해요. 동사 observe(관찰하다)를 형용사 observable(관찰 가능한)로 바꿔야 'make the seasons easily observable(계절을 쉽게 관찰 가능하게 만들다)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: observe(관찰하다, 동사) → observable(관찰 가능한, 형용사). make + 목적어 + 형용사

questions.passage: Conversely, among the largely nomadic peoples of Arabia, seasonal changes were less significant, the lunar calendar was a more __________ (sense) choice. That did not make it inevitable that Islam would use a lunar calendar and Roman Christianity a solar one.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: sense(명사) → sensible(형용사). 더 '합리적인' 선택
det.analysis: 관사 a와 명사 choice 사이, 그리고 more 뒤에는 형용사가 필요해요. 명사 sense(감각·분별)를 형용사 sensible(합리적인·분별 있는)로 바꿔야 'a more sensible choice(더 합리적인 선택)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: sense(분별, 명사) → sensible(합리적인, 형용사). a more ___ choice의 형용사 자리

questions.passage: All human cultures mark the passing of time by the differences they observe in the world around them. Our choice of which differences to mark depend firstly on what we can observe and secondly on what is important in our lives. How we mark the differences — the shapes of our calendars and our rituals — depends on the connections we make between those two things. In the agricultural society of pre-modern Europe, where higher latitudes make the seasons easily observable, it was natural to monitor the solar cycle. Conversely, among the largely nomadic peoples of Arabia, seasonal changes were less significant, the lunar calendar was a more sensible choice. That did not make it inevitable that Islam would use a lunar calendar and Roman Christianity a solar one, but political and religious decisions were made from options __________, filtered through tradition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정치·종교적 결정은 지리와 생활방식에 의해 제한된 선택지에서 이루어짐
det.analysis:
✅ ① limited by geography and lifestyle(지리와 생활방식에 의해 제한된) — 뒤의 'filtered through tradition'과 이어져 선택이 환경에 제약됨을 보여줌 ←정답
❌ ② expanded by trade and science(무역과 과학으로 확장된) — 선택지가 '제한된다'는 흐름과 정반대
❌ ③ chosen by religious leaders alone(종교 지도자만 선택한) — 지리·생활방식 요인을 무시한 서술
❌ ④ fixed by ancient written laws(고대 성문법으로 고정된) — 본문에 없는 근거
det.tip: options limited by geography and lifestyle = 지리·생활방식에 의해 제한된 선택지

questions.passage: All human cultures mark the passing of time by the differences they observe in the world around them. Our choice of which differences to mark depend firstly on what we can observe and secondly on what is important in our lives. How we mark the differences — the shapes of our calendars and our rituals — depends on __________. In the agricultural society of pre-modern Europe, where higher latitudes make the seasons easily observable, it was natural to monitor the solar cycle. Conversely, among the largely nomadic peoples of Arabia, seasonal changes were less significant, the lunar calendar was a more sensible choice. That did not make it inevitable that Islam would use a lunar calendar and Roman Christianity a solar one, but political and religious decisions were made from options limited by geography and lifestyle, filtered through tradition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 달력과 의식의 형태는 관찰 가능한 것과 중요한 것, 이 둘 사이의 연결에 달려 있음
det.analysis:
❌ ① the traditions passed down for centuries(수 세기 전해진 전통) — 뒤 문장 소재이지 이 빈칸의 핵심 연결어가 아님
❌ ② the tools available in each culture(각 문화의 이용 가능한 도구) — 본문에 없는 개념
✅ ③ the connections we make between those two things(그 두 가지 사이에 만드는 연결) — 앞서 말한 '관찰 가능한 것'과 '중요한 것' 두 요소의 연결 ←정답
❌ ④ the leaders who control every society(모든 사회를 통제하는 지도자들) — 본문 논지와 무관
det.tip: those two things = 관찰 가능한 것 + 삶에서 중요한 것. 둘 사이의 connections
